description: This file defines a Kotlin class 'ChatsFragment' which extends Android's Fragment. It manages a user interface component that displays a list of chat conversations, supports searching through chats, and opens a chat activity for a selected chat. It uses layout resources and interacts with other classes like ChatActivity.

classes.name: ChatsFragment
classes.description: Fragment that displays a list of chat conversations, supports search functionality, and handles opening individual chat screens.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout, sets up chat list and search functionality, and defines click behavior for chat items.
